verses.text: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said: "Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people. Those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away. Not one will escape.
Even if they dig down to the grave, my hand will take them from there. Even if they climb up to heaven, I will bring them down from there.
Even if they hide on the top of Mount Carmel, I will hunt them down and catch them. Even if they hide from me at the bottom of the sea, I will command the sea serpent to bite them there.
Even if they are driven into exile by their enemies, I will command the sword to kill them there. I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good."
The Lord, the GOD of Armies, touches the earth, and it melts, and everyone who lives in it mourns. The whole land rises like the Nile and then sinks again like the river of Egypt.
He builds his rooms high in the heavens and sets the dome of the sky over the earth. He calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the land. The LORD is his name.

"People of Israel, are you any more important to me than the people of Cush?" says the LORD. "Yes, I brought Israel up out of Egypt. But I also brought the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir.
"The eyes of the Lord GOD are watching this sinful kingdom. I will wipe it off the face of the earth. But I will not completely destroy the family of Jacob," says the LORD.
"For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations, the way grain is shaken in a sieve. Yet not one true kernel will fall to the ground.
All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, 'Disaster will never come near us or catch up with us.'
"On that day I will raise up the fallen tent of David. I will repair its broken walls and rebuild its ruins. I will build it up as it was long ago,
so that they may take over what is left of Edom and all the nations that belong to me," says the LORD, who will do these things.

"The days are coming," says the LORD, "when the one plowing will catch up with the one harvesting, and the one stomping grapes will catch up with the one planting seed. Sweet new wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills.
I will bring my people Israel back from exile. They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine. They will make gardens and eat their fruit.
I will plant Israel in their own land, and they will never again be pulled up out of the land I have given them," says the LORD your God.
